decks.notes: This Death & Taxes deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies while efficiently deploying threats of its own. With a mix of disruptive creatures like Thalia and Spirit of the Labyrinth, and powerful equipment like Umezawa's Jitte and Batterskull, the deck aims to control the board and pressure opponents into making unfavorable decisions. Cards like Aether Vial and Recruiter of the Guard provide consistency and flexibility, while Wasteland and Rishadan Port disrupt opponents' mana bases. The addition of Yorion as a companion adds extra value by allowing for additional creatures to be blinked for added value.

The deck focuses on assembling the Aluren combo, which allows the player to play creatures with converted mana cost 3 or less for free. By utilizing cards like Baleful Strix, Shardless Agent, and Ice-Fang Coatl, the deck aims to generate card advantage and control the board while setting up the combo. Additionally, cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance provide additional value and disruption. The deck uses a mix of efficient creatures, cantrips, and disruption spells to create a strong and adaptable game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful equipment combo using cards like Colossus Hammer and Stoneforge Mystic. By equipping creatures like Ornithopter with multiple high-impact equipment pieces, the deck aims to deal a lethal amount of damage in a single turn. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Esper Sentinel helps control the board and disrupt opponents' strategies, while Urza's Saga and Mox Opal provide mana acceleration to quickly deploy threats. The deck's goal is to overwhelm opponents with a quick and powerful combo before they can react.

The deck focuses on using efficient and powerful tempo plays to disrupt the opponent while building a strong board presence. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure the opponent, while also running disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to control the game. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the right cards at the right time. It aims to quickly close out the game by applying pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to establish board presence quickly with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and White Plume Adventurer. The key strategy is to disrupt opponents with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Swords to Plowshares while maintaining tempo by utilizing mana acceleration from cards like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb. The deck also includes elements of control with cards like Palace Jailer and Solitude, allowing the player to maintain advantage and pressure the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to outpace opponents and control the game through its aggressive and disruptive creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly bring out powerful threats such as Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The deck aims to use aggressive tactics and tempo plays to control the game and apply pressure on the opponent, often relying on reanimation effects and efficient removal spells to push through for a victory. The deck's key strengths lie in its combination of disruptive elements and powerful threats to quickly overwhelm the opponent.

The focus of this deck is to establish early board control with aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder, taking advantage of the initiative in the match. This deck aims to disrupt opponents with disruptive spells like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude while maintaining a high tempo with cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal. The addition of cards like Cavern of Souls and Palace Jailer gives the deck additional protection and removal options, allowing it to maintain pressure on opponents and control the game state.

The deck focuses on being aggressive and tempo-oriented, utilizing cheap spells like Lightning Bolt, Brainstorm, and Ponder to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to flip Delver of Secrets quickly while also utilizing disruptive elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect its threats. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide powerful finishers that can quickly close out games. The manabase is streamlined to support the deck's strategy and maximize efficiency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on applying early pressure and disrupting the opponent's strategy with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to control the game with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder, while using cards like Swords to Plowshares for removal. The deck takes advantage of mana acceleration provided by cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to quickly deploy threats. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruption spells, this deck aims to maintain control of the game and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells to control the tempo of the game while applying pressure with creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan using cards like Daze, Force of Will, and Wasteland, while also efficiently drawing through the deck with Ponder, Brainstorm, and Expressive Iteration. The inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional reach to finish off opponents. The overall strategy revolves around leveraging efficient spells and creatures to maintain a fast-paced and aggressive playstyle.

The main idea of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Hymn to Tourach, counter spells like Force of Will, and removal spells like Snuff Out and Unholy Heat. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and filter through its library with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. The win condition is to control the board using efficient blockers like Baleful Strix and Dauthi Voidwalker, while finishing off the opponent with efficient threats like Murktide Regent and burn spells like Lightning Bolt.

The main concept of this Legacy Control-Stoneblade deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence with efficient threats like Stoneforge Mystic, Delver of Secrets, and Murktide Regent. The deck focuses on gaining card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Ponder, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Daze and Stifle to control the pace of the game. With a mix of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as counterspells like Force of Will, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful, high-impact threats such as Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze. The deck also has ways to bring back creatures from the graveyard with Reanimate and puts pressure on the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the game through a combination of disruption and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly playing and protecting powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while controlling the opponent's board with burn spells and counterspells. The key is to maintain tempo by playing threats early on and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes card selection cards like Ponder and Brainstorm to ensure consistency in drawing threats and answers. With a mix of aggression and control, this UR Tempo deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill opponents' entire decks in one turn. It uses cards like Goblin Engineer and Breya's Apprentice to search for and recur key pieces, while also disrupting opponents with Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast. The deck aims to control the board with powerful artifacts and efficient removal spells, ultimately winning through a devastating combo finish. The strategy revolves around generating mana quickly, protecting the combo pieces, and dismantling opponents' strategies while setting up for a game-winning mill.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and Narcomoeba to quickly mill through the deck and create a graveyard that can be utilized for a powerful Dread Return combo. The deck includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Cabal Therapy, as well as card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. Teferi, Time Raveler provides protection and utility, while Baleful Strix provides additional card advantage. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or overwhelming board presence.
